name: solution-studio
description: Turn project context into requirements, solution designs, and dependency-aware execution plans.

interface.shortDescription: Requirements, solution designs, and dependency plans.
interface.longDescription: An Apple-inspired project planning workbench that grounds requirements in existing project evidence or a greenfield brief, turns them into traceable solution designs, and renders executable plans as dependency graphs with clear deliverables and acceptance criteria.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this project and create requirements, a solution design, and an execution plan.
Turn this product idea into a traceable design and dependency roadmap.
Review the current plan and show which tasks are ready to execute.
